title: Slow cooker Italian sausage and peppers

items: 2 lb sweet Italian sausage links (or hot, or half and half)
3 bell peppers (1 green, 1 red, 1 yellow), sliced ½ inch thick
2 large yellow onions, halved and sliced ½ inch thick from root to tip

steps: Heat a griddle or 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat (375–400°F). Lay the sausages down with space between them. Cook 2 min per side, rolling a quarter turn each time, until all 4 sides are a deep chestnut brown, about 8 min total. If using a skillet, work in 2 batches so they brown instead of steam. They do not need to be cooked through.
Move the sausages to a plate and turn off the heat. Pour the ½ cup water onto the browned spots and scrape with a metal spatula while it bubbles. Pour the liquid into the slow cooker.
Spread the peppers, onions and garlic in the bottom of the slow cooker. Set the sausages on top.

In a medium bowl, stir the tomato paste, oregano, basil, red pepper flakes, salt and black pepper into the crushed tomatoes. Pour the sauce over the sausages. Do not add any other liquid; the vegetables release plenty.

Cover and cook on high for 3 hr without stirring or lifting the lid, until the peppers are tender but still hold their shape and the sausages read 160°F inside. If the sauce looks thin, prop the lid open a crack for the last 20 min.

Near the end of cooking, set an oven rack about 6 inches from the broiler and heat the broiler to high. Pull some bread out of the top half of each roll to make a shallow boat. Butter the cut sides, set the rolls cut side up on a rimmed baking sheet and broil 60–90 sec until golden.

Slice the sausages into coins or leave them whole. Fill the rolls with sausage, peppers, onions and sauce, then top each with a slice of provolone. Broil about 2 min, until the cheese melts and bubbles. Serve right away.
tips: Keep the peppers at least ½ inch thick and use yellow onions; thin strips turn to mush and sweet or red onions change the sauce.
Skip the rolls and serve over soft polenta with parmesan, rice or rigatoni, or in bowls with crusty bread and a sharp salad.
To char the vegetables first, cut them ¾ inch thick, sear them on the griddle and cut the slow cooker time to 2 hr on high.
storage: Refrigerate the sausage and peppers in an airtight container up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months. Thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat in a covered pot over medium-low heat, stirring gently, until steaming and 165°F. Assemble sandwiches fresh.
